subject: Eval window staffing calendar & safeguards
messages:
From: Soojin Lee <soojin_lee@redwood.example>
To: laura_bennett@redwood.example, marcus_lin@redwood.example, monica_patel@redwood.example
Cc: vivek_kulkarni@redwood.example
Date: Tue, 15 Jun 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Eval window staffing calendar & safeguards

Team —

Attached is the first draft of the annual evaluation window calendar (see 2027_review_calendar_v1.ics) and a short guidance doc for managers handling sensitive roles (manager_guidance_sensitive_roles.docx). Key asks: 

- Review the calendar dates & staffing checkpoints (especially the manager calibration week) and flag conflicts by EOD Thursday.
- For sensitive roles (privileged access, IR, legal), confirm fallback reviewers and an alternate escalation path.
- We plan a controlled pilot (5 teams) as a quiet launch the first week of the window; volunteers?

Notes: the goal is to avoid mass manager tasks in the same week and to ensure HR has all redlines handled before wider communications. Monica — can you confirm the updated form workflow and the secure access list for reviewer logs?

I put a Drive doc for live edits: https://drive.google.com/open?id=1a2b3c-review-calendar

Thanks,

— Soojin
Director, People Ops Enablement
Redwood Inference

> Subject: Re: Eval window staffing calendar & safeguards
>
> Thanks Soojin — I reviewed the calendar and the guidance doc. HR has pushed the new manager acknowledgement step into the form workflow; I attached the updated guidance file for sensitive roles.
>
> Quick answers:
> - We can enable a reviewer access log with restricted read permissions (audit trail) — will need to test with legal before the pilot.
> - For fallback reviewers, please provide a primary + two backups per role (name + email).
> - For the quiet pilot, HR can ingest the first batch and run calibration with two HR leads observing.
>
> Attaching: manager_guidance_sensitive_roles.docx (updated v1.1)
>
> Monica Patel
> Senior People Operations Partner
> Redwood Inference
